SHFE prices have fluctuated significantly since the last report, the daily official cash month price falling from RMB 50,000/t on 14th August to RMB 46,730/t by 19th August then rose to a new annual high of RMB 50,300/t on 26th August. SHFE prices have followed the lead of LME prices. Positive macro data from US and Europe, the weak US dollar and the bounce of oil prices have all supported bullish expectations for the copper price. However, the SHFE price has shown some Aug-08 Nov-08 Feb-09 May-09 Aug-09 Data: SHFE reluctance to follow the LME due to worries about fundamentals and concern there might be a tightening of Chinese monetary policy. The SHFE/LME ratio started to fall to a level which could lead to arbitrage encouraging the purchase of cathodes from SHFE and sale on the LME. The premium of imported cathodes has fallen to $70-90/t in the past two weeks, and little business has been heard on imported SXEW cathodes. Shanghai spot cathode has maintained either a discount or a premium of ±150RMB/t, and was reported at a discount of RMB 250/t today. Chinese market participants are uncertain about the outlook for the price and expect volatile trading to continue. However, although LME and SHFE stocks continue to build, participants do not expect LME prices to fall below $5,800/t in the next two weeks given the strength of the current positive market sentiment. Several leading smelters expected prices to rise above $7,200/t before the end of the year. © 2009 CRU International Limited **confidential** **September 2009** **www.crumonitor.com** # **Economic fundamentals look strong for the remainder of 2009** China’s economy seems to have shrugged off the relative weakness it experienced in the first half, as Q3 GDP is expected to show growth of around 8.5% compared to 2008, according to a forecast by the State Information Centre. China’s July power consumption was up by 6% y-o-y and 10.9% m-o-m to 342 billion KWh, according to China’s National Energy Administration. September and October are the traditional peak season for China’s real estate and automotive industries, hence higher copper demand is expected in the next two months. Loose monetary policy has been a key measure to support economic growth. While China’s new loans shrank to RMB 355.9 billion ($52.04 billion) in July from 1.53 trillion RMB in June, new loans are expected to rebound to about RMB 500 billion ($7

3 billion) in August according to the official China Securities Journal. The Central government has confirmed that there is minimal risk of inflation by the end of this year and Chinese banks may lend RMB 3 trillion ($438.96 billion) in 2H 2009. # **Scrap market expected to tighten again** SHFE inventoryChinese importsheads higher (000t)of scrap (monthly)

China’s official refined copper import in July was down to 292,226t (lower than the preliminary number reported in our last monitor), but scrap rebounded to 450,000t, 61.3% up on June imports. Most smelters are running at more than 80% of full capacity because availability of raw materials has improved. However, one leading smelter told us that they expect that scrap supply will tighten again in September or October. # **Japanese enter negotiations over sulphuric acid anti-dumping measures** Japanese smelters are reported to have approached the nine leading Chinese smelters that petitioned the Chinese to impose anti-dumping actions over Japanese imports of sulphuric acid for negotiations. The demand for copper wirerod Data: GTIS continues to remain stable as it is closely related to the investment in the power sector, and more orders for September have been reported. © 2009 CRU International Ltd **confidential** Page 2 of 3 **September 2009** www.crumonitor.com # **New wirerod capacity starts up** Two new copper wirerod projects were commissioned in August. Amer International commissioned a 300,000t/y copper wirerod and 100,000t/y copper wire project on 28th August in Tongling, Anhui. JNMC is also reported to have commissioned its 100,000t/y wirerod project on 27th August. The project increases JNMC’s wirerod production capacity to 100,000t/y from 25,000t/y previously. # **SHFE stocks hit a two-year high** SHFE inventory stocks rose for a fifth consecutive week, hitting a two-year high.
